answer: A bond is refunded only after 12 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The yarrow counter is kept in signal and whisper shows each reset. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 12 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 5 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
